description: Combine 8cfbce's direct 128-thread TMA acquire waits and removed publish barrier with 9e731's eight-phase P16/C16 post-flush lookahead tail. Preserve the fixed sixteen-stage stationary first 24 epochs and shared-buffer reuse; benchmark the minimal additive merge first, then bracket a six-phase tail and isolate tail-driver live ranges only if the combined head remains full-valid and faster.

Minimal additive merge of 8cfbce's fixed sixteen-stage stationary panels 0:384 with direct 128-thread TMA acquire waits and 9e731's eight-phase P16/C16 double-buffer tail. The tail reuses retired TMA/cTail storage, leaving the 135168-byte shared launch size unchanged. Full official, differential, invariance, and off-grid guards pass. Dense n512 measured 15474.304 us, 1.31% below direct-wait parent 15680.428 and 0.60% below tail parent 15568.006; suite geomean measured 1424.026803 through untouched-route variance.

Bracketed the direct-wait combination at a six-phase P16/C16 tail by moving LOOKAHEAD_START from panel 384 to 416; panels 0:384 remain the fixed sixteen-stage stationary path and panels 384:416 use the all-warp SIMT tail. Full official and all guards pass. Dense n512 measured 15506.755 us, 32.451 us (0.21%) slower than the eight-phase merge but still 1.11% below direct-wait parent 15680.428; suite geomean measured 1419.742030 through untouched-route variance.

Returned to the eight-phase boundary and isolated the complete post-flush P16/C16 pipeline in one noinline device function so stationary/TMA and tail pointer/register lifetimes receive separate call frames. Full official and all guards pass. Dense n512 measured 15550.601 us, 76.297 us (0.49%) slower than inline merge 15474.304 but still below direct-wait parent 15680.428 and tail parent 15568.006; suite geomean was 1423.182950. Profiling follows to quantify whether the device-call trade changed spills.

Reduced the isolated tail driver from nine pointer arguments to acm/tau/shared only, reconstructing constant shared offsets inside its separate call frame. Full official and all guards pass. Dense n512 improved from nine-argument noinline 15550.601 to 15510.970 us (0.25%), leaving it 36.666 us (0.24%) slower than inline merge 15474.304 while still below both parents; suite geomean improved to 1420.251602. Final profiling follows to measure the shared-spill response.

Completed the direct-wait/TMA + post-flush lookahead combination and requested follow-ups. Minimal additive commit 2061b37e1 preserves fixed sixteen-stage stationary panels 0:384, all-128-thread TMA acquire waits, and retired-buffer reuse for the eight-phase P16/C16 tail; it is full-valid and measured 15474.304 us dense n512 / 1424.026803 us suite versus parents 15680.428 and 15568.006 dense. Six-phase 8a1078922 measured 15506.755 / 1419.742030. Nine-argument noinline tail-driver isolation 9d7c2e830 measured 15550.601 / 1423.182950; NCU shifted spills to 61.44 KB local + 2.49 MB shared, with 64 regs/thread and 135.17 KiB dynamic shared. Three-argument isolation f531395ff recovered to 15510.970 / 1420.251602 and nsys 15.314123 ms, but NCU recorded 276.48 KB local + 2.92 MB shared, 49.92% occupancy, and 60.70% no-eligible cycles. Thus the measured inline merge has the lowest dense benchmark, while six-phase carries the lowest measured full-suite aggregate amid untouched-route variance. Continue with partial live-range isolation around only slot selection/apply, a statically unrolled fixed-phase tail that removes dynamic slot pointers without a call frame, or frontier barrier restructuring. All trials pass official/differential/invariance/off-grid guards; profiles are commit-keyed under autocuda/profiles/2026-07-06-18-24-02. No leaderboard submission was made because it is closed.
